Can I gift ₹50L to my HUF?.prompt: Can I gift ₹50L to my HUF?
Can I gift ₹50L to my HUF?.answer:
Yes, you can transfer ₹50L to Rahul HUF, but with important caveats:

**Tax implications:**
• Gift from a member to HUF is **not taxable** in the HUF's hands
• However, income arising from such gifted assets may be **clubbed** with your income under **Section 64(2)** of the Income Tax Act
• No gift tax applies (gift tax abolished in 1998)

**Compliance:**
• Document the transfer via HUF bank account credit
• Board resolution / HUF deed reference recommended
• Update Schedule AL in HUF ITR if assets acquired

**Recommendation:** Route via HUF current account (SBI). Consult your CA for clubbing implications on future income.

What happens if I sell my Jaipur propert.answer:
Selling Jaipur commercial property (current value ₹1.5 Cr, cost ₹1.2 Cr):

**Capital gains:** LTCG of ₹30L (held > 24 months)
**Tax:** ₹3.75L at 12.5% (post July 2024 LTCG rate) + surcharge

**Exemption options:**
• **Section 54:** Reinvest in residential property within 2 years → full exemption
• **Section 54EC:** Invest in NHAI/REC bonds within 6 months → max ₹50L exemption

**Other costs:**
• Stamp duty (buyer): 6% in Rajasthan
• TDS @ 1% on sale value if > ₹50L (Section 194-IA)

Net proceeds after tax (no exemption): ~₹1.41 Cr
